promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-02 (nyiso-113). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-02-nyiso-113-li-locational (bundle results/calibration/nyiso113_lilocational_B). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, C3c the sole ledgered caveat, UNCHANGED. ONE delta vs the nyiso-112 keeper: nyiso_li_locational_reserve=true. ZERO free parameters (ledger 29 -> 30 entries, n_residual unchanged at 6). WHAT THE DELTA IS: the PUBLISHED NYISO Long Island (Zone K) locational reserve ladder -- li_10min_total 120 MW all hours and li_30min_total 270 MW off-peak / 540 MW on-peak, both at the published $25/MW value (Ancillary Services Manual 6.8 items 10 and 15), from the SAME Locational Reserve Requirements posting that already grounds the model's NYC and East families (data/raw/NYISO-AS/requirements/nyiso_locational_reserve_requirements.csv, rows region=LI, regime v2021 spanning all of 2023-2025). The on/off-peak boundary the posting leaves undefined resolves to the tariff's own MST 2.15 On-Peak calendar (07:00-23:00 EPT Mon-Fri excl. NERC holidays) -- a published calendar rule that regenerates for any forward year, rule 13 [R-MEASURED] admissible. THE MODEL CARRIED NO ZONE-K FAMILY AT ALL: a rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] omission of a published requirement, the same class nyiso-83/84 fixed one tier up. HOW IT WAS FOUND: the rule-28(c) MATRIX-GAP SWEEP, which generalised the nyiso-112 lesson ('a solve-affecting field with no matrix row is a mechanism nobody can see') into a mechanical census. 25 nyiso_* ScenarioConfig fields had NO matrix row, 5 more were prose-only, and 17 were ARMED ON THE KEEPER WITH NO CELL ANYWHERE. CI never caught it because check_mechanism_matrix's diff gate only fires on fields ADDED in the same PR, so everything predating the gate is invisible to it -- a standing blind spot in every ISO column. This field had never been armed in any bundle and carried no rejection anywhere in the record. RULE 19 [R-ONE-MECH] DISCHARGED BY PROOF, NOT ASSERTION: a family row is sum_{z in region} R[c,z] + shortfall >= requirement, so an armed family with the same reserve class, a SUBSET region and a requirement at least as large would force this one slack. No armed family is Zone-K-scoped -- the smallest armed regions containing Long Island are SENY and East, whose R-sums run over strictly more zones. The sibling candidate nyiso_east_reserve_families IS dominated by that same test (east_10min_spin 330 MW by nyc_10min_total 500 MW and by east_10min_total 1,200 MW; east_30min_total 1,200 MW by seny_30min_total 1,300 MW) and is recorded INERT rather than armed. RULE-19 PRECONDITION ON THE nyiso-110 EXHAUSTION FINDING, ALSO BY MEASUREMENT: nyiso-110's refutation is that reserve-eligible HYDRO's own capability keeps the aggregate rows slack in every hour. That argument is zone-blind, and NYISO hydro is 100 % UPSTATE -- Upstate_West 4,094.9/4,035.2/4,035.2 MW plus Capital_Hudson 554.3/551.9/551.9 MW, with Long Island carrying EXACTLY 0.0 MW in all three years. The resource that makes the aggregate slack is physically incapable of supplying a Zone-K row. GATES: K1 exactly one config delta. K2 control integrity BYTE-IDENTICAL -- the same-HEAD zero-delta control (2026-08-02-nyiso-113-control-zerodelta) reproduces the committed nyiso-112 keeper at EXACTLY 0.0 MW on every one of 122,640 class-hours in each of the three years. K3 liveness: the family binds, and binds ONLY where its own requirement exceeds Zone-K headroom -- Zone-K thermal headroom falls below the HOURLY requirement in exactly 5 hours of 2025 (h4193-4195, h4217-4218, the June 24-25 event that carries the five highest Long Island prices) and 0 hours of 2023/2024 once the published on/off-peak step is honoured, and the solved reserve dual moves in exactly those hours (2 in 2023, 0 in 2024). The 10-minute limb never binds: Zone-K quick-start headroom bottoms out at 596.8/490.7/379.7 MW = 5.0/4.1/3.2x its 120 MW requirement. K5 span [2023, 2024, 2025]; the holdout spend freeze is ACTIVE and untouched. NO KILL GATE FIRES, AND EVERY SCORED CRITERION IS IDENTICAL TO THE SAME-HEAD CONTROL'S: C1 14/14 all-class and 10/10 free-class, C2, C3a, C3b, C4, C6, C7 and C8 all PASS in both arms; C3c is the sole caveat and is UNCHANGED at 3/0/14 h >$300 against a measured 10/12/42, so the arm regresses nothing and spends no caveat slot. Zero slack and zero dump in every zone-hour. THE CASE IS STRUCTURAL, NOT A FIT CLAIM, and it was stated in advance. The whole visible price effect is one number -- the 2025 Long Island maximum 483.37 -> 489.62 $/MWh, the published $25/MW demand-curve tier doing exactly what its own value permits -- and no part of the promotion rests on it. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] / rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]: the published requirement belongs in the model because NYISO enforces it, whatever it does to the residual. Same ground pjm-140 and nyiso-111 were promoted on. REPORTED, NOT HIDDEN (rule 14): the pre-registration's K3/K4 gates were specified on the per-zone reserve_price column, which is a SYSTEM-LEVEL (T,) series broadcast identically to every zone (run_calibration_full.py:925/1028) and therefore CANNOT observe a locational dual. Scored on it the arm first read INERT -- an artifact of the instrument, not a result. The gates were re-scored on Zone-K unit-hourly headroom and the solved dual's timing. A second correction on the record: the pre-registration's capacity-vs-demand screen (LI peak demand 5,537 MW vs Zone-K thermal nameplate 5,146.5 MW) does NOT imply a headroom collapse, because reserve class 1 is idle-allowed and Long Island imports a large share of its own peak. STANDING GAP FOR ALL SIX ISOs: no bundle persists a per-family reserve dual (DispatchResult.reserve_price_by_family is discarded at persist time), so no locational reserve family's binding is observable from a committed bundle anywhere -- filed on the new ledger entry. PREREG-nyiso113-li-locational-reserve-2026-08-02.md carries the binding no-tuning clause: the published levels, the $25/MW value and the On-Peak calendar may not be re-levelled, re-scoped, partially applied or re-derived in response to this result. Evidence: results/calibration/_nyiso113_li_locational_ab.json, _nyiso113_zonek_headroom.json, _nyiso113_locational_reserve_screen.json; FINDING-nyiso113-matrix-gap-sweep-2026-08-02.md. PRIOR KEEPER: 2026-08-02-nyiso112-ramp-plus-peaker, superseded not retracted -- its ramp-envelope and NYSDEC 227-3 mechanisms are both carried forward in this recipe.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
